info.title: AFRICLUB operator public-source publication API
info.description: Staging source candidate. Only configured Rayon tenant is available. Runtime ctx.access authenticates human operators; the private service enforces live grants. Access cookies are handled by the browser. Raw identity headers and request-body approvers are never authority. No supporter authentication or financial commands. Read-only candidate inspection and review recovery support the separately enabled same-origin operator interface. Opening a page or preview never publishes. UI assets are directly served by the authenticated Worker, without Static Assets routing.
